author: Topsy
description:
Pre-orders for the new Legio Custodes Codex for 11th edition Warhammer 40,000 open this weekend. With the codex, all the models released for The Horus Heresy over the past while finally become playable in 40k too. Good reason to take a closer look at all the new kits. In this post, you'll find every review and unboxing, including high-res sprue images and all the build options.

### The Emperor's Finest unboxed

The overhaul and plastic transformation of the Horus Heresy Custodes model range kicked off with the Legio Custodes Battle Group box. Sadly it's out of stock now, but our in-depth review still has high-res sprue photos for the Shield Captain, the Custodian and Sentinel Guard, the Contemptor-Achillus Dreadnought / Contemptor-Galatus Dreadnought, and the Caladius Annihilator, plus a full list of build options and what to watch out for:
